# PiTTy 1.1.0

## Side-by-side diffs

Edit diffs now show the old version on the left and the new version on the right, each with its own line numbers. A changed line sits next to its replacement. Transcripts narrower than 90 columns keep the unified diff.

## One speed verdict

The sidebar still shows the latest reply's tokens per second and first-token time, and the model's medians on their own row. The faster, usual or slower verdict now uses one combined number: the speed of a 500-token reply including the wait for the first token. A fast stream with a slow start reads slower.

## Recommended plugins from Settings

Settings (`Ctrl+X`) has a **Recommended plugins** page. It runs founder setup as a dry run and lists each package: subagents, compaction, memory, PiTTy-BTW side questions, curated skills and agents, and tools. Press Enter to install. Credentials and model defaults stay unchanged. Restart PiTTy afterward.

## Quieter notices

Finished background jobs from `pi-bg-bash` show as one row with their status, job id, command and run time, and the last three output lines under it. Other extension messages, subagent notifications and the working indicator use the same quiet row style.

```sh
pitty upgrade
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mistrjirka/PiTTy/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)
